title: Linear glTF baseColorFactor stored as an sRGB colour, then linearized again in the PBR shader
fix_note: issue closed by the maintainer, fix commit not linked; the fixed variant applies the fix stated in the issue (convert the loaded factor linear -> sRGB once at load, 0.5 -> 186)
expected_finding: the host copies glTF's linear base_color_factor into colDiffuse as code values (x * 255 / 255) while the shader declares and treats colDiffuse as sRGB (pow 2.2 decode): the linear colour is decoded a second time and every glTF material draws too dark
